costs.spread: Already charged through entry ask / exit bid; never add it again
costs.stressShares: Same whole-share size; report capacity breach, never rescale after outcomes

quality.quoteQuality: Required but not guaranteed fills; all thresholds proposed, unapproved

identity: Authentic US common-stock stable ID/CIK/asset reference as known at signal and entry; exclude ADRs/funds/warrants/rights/unknown from verified stock claims; retain all research rows
zad: Existing owner mark required for executable eligibility; unknown remains research; existing90day non-halal exclusion untouched; no automatic owner confirmation

controls.selection: Same session and entry clock; applicable rule/identity/ZAD/freshness/price/liquidity predicates; same SIC3, price and prior20d dollar-volume within factor2; deterministic SHA256(seed,event,securityId), no outcome selection/replacement
controls.primary: net USD /1000 allocation minus equal-weight3matched controls at identical clocks/costs
secondary: SPY same clocks/budget/costs as research benchmark, no purchase/ZAD promotion
Remove largest2net winners; report net and paired excess again

missingness.noQuote: UNKNOWN/censored, never fill at stop/close/last known price
missingness.haltGapDilutionDelisting: Preserve original source/action clocks and full paths; no deletion or split-repair hindsight; unresolved terminal value remains censored
missingness.missingControl: Keep candidate/payoff and unmatched reason; primary paired result unresolved, no substitute chosen afterward
missingness.duplicate: One security/day/track logical case; exact duplicates deduplicated; conflicts UNKNOWN; complete rejection log retained
missingness.capacity: Fixed chronological allocation, max5positions, one per issuer; capital/risk exclusions logged; missing exit does not free capital
missingness.noOutcome: Never count missing outcome as a zero or discard it

inference.method: Fixed two-primary Bonferroni; cluster resampling, fixed seed1337/10000replicates; no interim efficacy looks
inference.priorSearch: Both selected after existing research; full prior studies retained. New two-test family does not erase prior search. Only later predeclared untouched confirmation could support a new claim.
gateProposals: Net expectancy>0 and paired excess lower97.5%one-sided bound>0
Profit factor>=1.2; complete conservative uncertainty/missingness disclosure
Net and paired excess remain nonnegative without largest2winners
Nonnegative mean at1.5xfees+extra slippage; no stress capacity breach
Full mark-to-market portfolio drawdown<=10%; missing marks unresolved
No issuer>10%or industry>25%of gains; report all concentration failures

stopping.calibration: Separate operational calibration, never pooled as untouched confirmation
stopping.safety: Stop new enrollments for budget/authentication/source/identity/clock/coverage failure; preserve and finish known followups within approved scope, do not fabricate exits
stopping.loss: Stop new paper allocation at10%account drawdown; keep all original cases/outcomes and report stop; cannot pass stopped study
stopping.noExtension: Fixed final deadline/sample ends even if inconvenient; insufficient samples stay INSUFFICIENT, no automatic extension
stopping.adoption: No collection or protocol activation from software tests

results.analysisPerformed: Synthetic software tests only, no new historical/market experiment

reservedData.priorExamined: All retained2021–2026archives and existing paper observations are examined/development evidence, never untouched holdout
reservedData.confirmation: Only a separately approved future start/session list and frozen rule/collector hashes, before observing outcomes

primaryHypothesis: Among eligible timely confirmed earnings releases with a positive first15minute reaction, first breakout BBO entries outperform symmetrically selected non-earnings reaction controls after whole-share costs over the remainder of that session; conditional association, not causation or whole-market coverage.
population: All authenticated ZAD-eligible US common stocks in predeclared complete session roster, price>=5/prior20d dollar-volume>=5M; small caps eligible, no future winner shortlist.

rule.knownRelease: Official issuer/SEC primary earnings release and original publish/receipt before entry; no inferred timestamp or EPS-consensus requirement
rule.formation: First15regular-session minutes: complete raw bar series, close>=prior close*1.03
rule.entry: First eligible fresh executable-model ask above first15minute high from open+15min through open+30min; no chasing/re-entry
rule.stop: First observed executable-model bid<=first15minute low; use that actual bid, including gaps; no fill at stop price
rule.holding: No overnight position; otherwise first fresh BBO at/after sessionClose−30seconds; missing/halt exit unresolved

lineage.changes: Different hypothesis: first15minute price reaction and one-session exit; removes EPS surprise prerequisite, does NOT reuse40-session PEAD returns as evidence; newB proposal, not a renamed old verdict.

timeline: 10separate calibration sessions then up to252scheduled sessions;120pairs may take6–12months or fail enrollment. No promise of edge.
